ergonomic_guidelines.hazard: Repetitive hand-arm strain and crush hazards
preventive_actions: Ensure two-hand safety controls are active
Maintain anti-vibration gloves and adjust die table height to elbow level (95-105 cm)
Rotate press operators every 2 hours to avoid muscular fatigue

ergonomic_guidelines.hazard: Prolonged standing, coolant mist inhalation, eye strain
preventive_actions: Deploy anti-fatigue rubber matting in front of machines
Ensure chip guards and mist collectors are running
Enforce 20-20-20 visual rest intervals for tool inspection

ergonomic_guidelines.hazard: UV flash burn, toxic fumes, high heat exposure
preventive_actions: Local exhaust ventilation positioned 15 cm from weld joint
Mandatory hydration breaks (250 ml water/electrolytes every 45 mins in summer)
